added.summary: Ready checks with participant responses, game-owned countdown text, changeable local accept/decline intents, closed, loading, empty and disabled states.
Map voting with stable option-id intents, game-owned tallies and winners, visible local selection and per-option disabled reasons.

Spectator HUD with keyed follow intents, current subject, free camera, previous/next and Leave actions; loading never removes the exit. All three support phone text, bounded scrolling and token/part styling.
